_comment: Niche configuration for the Able To Love launch campaign. Keys map 1:1 to the bot's config store (see apps/dashboard/src/app/settings). Load via the setup/settings wizard or seed directly. Read marketing/02-messaging-guide.md before enabling auto-approve.
content_tone: warm, real, and confident — like a friend who's been there. Hopeful and often funny. Never pitying, never inspiration-porn, never clinical. Centers agency and belonging.
reply_personality: warm, respectful, and community-first; affirms disabled identity; never uses pity or 'inspiring/despite' framing; escalates anything sensitive to a human

must_do: add alt text to every image
keep human review on all community-facing replies
never_do: fake profiles, bought followers, or engagement pods

notes: auto_approve_content is intentionally false: for a dating app in a marginalized community, trust is the product. A human approves community-facing content until brand voice is proven stable.
